limits: These are public templates and newly authored tasks, not live customer deliveries or human usability sessions.
Known, supplemental known-source, long known-source task and released held-out first attempts must retain separate denominators.
Frozen label scores are retained even where a broader page-copy requirement admits a defensible unknown; qualifications are not retroactive relabeling.
No inspection of omitted JS/CSS/backend, no actual credentials or money moved, no browser rendering observed.
Source quote existence is not source inference entailment, complete list/relational coverage, runtime truth or final buyer acceptance.
Application rejected status for Clean Blog means no valid report admitted; its fail-closed response is safe behavior, not an unsafe false pass.
